_comment: Canonical MCP server list. Edit this file, then run scripts/utilities/mcp-sync.mjs. Secrets use ${VAR} placeholders resolved from /run/agenix/mcp-secrets.json (agenix) or the environment. Zed starts servers that have headers via scripts/utilities/mcp-http.sh, which fills ${VAR} when it connects. `enabled: false` hides a server from Zed/opencode; Cursor and pi keep the entry.

Polar.description: Polar billing: products, subscriptions, orders, customers.

axiom.description: Axiom observability: query logs, traces and datasets.

openseo.description: OpenSEO: keyword, backlink and SEO research.

twenty-crm.description: Twenty CRM: people, companies, opportunities, notes.

coverlttr.description: Coverlttr production MCP: companies, templates, cover letters.

coolify-hetzner.description: Coolify on the Hetzner server: apps, deployments, logs.

coolify-home.description: Coolify on the home server: apps, deployments, logs.

inngest-dev.description: Local Inngest dev server event and function inspection.

figma.description: Figma: design files, frames, components and tokens (OAuth).

playwright.description: Browser automation over the running Helium CDP session.

DbFlux.description: DBFlux: query and manage local database connections.
